terminalBusy: Exit the full-screen program before running shortcuts
youWillNeedToSignInAgain: You will need to sign in again.
overviewDescription: Cluster health, account availability and service quality over the last hour
statisticsDescription: Today's and historical requests, spend, tokens and cache; tenants can view usage per available VM
logsDescription: Request history with filtering, export and detailed views
gatewayWorkerDescription: Codex forwarding workers and capacity status
gatewayWorkerLoadFailed: Unable to load Gateway Worker status.
gatewayWorkerFactsError: Failed to read the control-plane database
gatewayWorkerControlPlaneInboxCounts: processed {{done}} · awaiting comparison {{pending}} · differences {{diff}} · failed or invalid {{failed}}
codexAccountsDescription: Manage Codex accounts, authorization, proxies, groups and scheduling
codexAccountsWorkerScheduling: Accounts are scheduled inside the Worker
codexGroupUnavailable: Group #{{id}} (disabled or not selectable; can only be removed)
codexCreateHelp: Choose a proxy and groups, then authorize. The first authorization creates the account.
codexEditHelp: Leave the proxy empty to keep the current one.
codexAuthorizeHelp: Reauthorization keeps the name, groups, proxy and capacity settings.
codexProjectionPending: Saved; the credential has not been captured from the Gateway Worker yet, so the account is not scheduled. Refresh it from the account page shortly.
codexNoGroups: Create an active OpenAI group with Codex models in Groups first.
codexInlineProxyHelp: A pasted proxy is added to the proxy pool and bound to this account; check it from the Proxy tab.
codexInlineProxyVendorHelp: For supplier accounts a pasted proxy is stored on this account only and is not added to the platform proxy pool.
codexProxyDescription: The Gateway Worker reaches OpenAI through this proxy. An account must keep an outbound proxy, so it can be switched but not unbound.
codexProxyNotPooled: This proxy was pasted manually and is not in the proxy pool, so it has no health, latency or exit location. Add it to the pool to probe it, check its location and include it in scheduled probes.
codexProxyPooled: Added to the proxy pool and bound to this account
codexNoWorker: No Gateway Worker is available. Check instances before authorization.
codexDraftLocked: Account settings are locked for this authorization draft. Close and reopen to change them.
codexEmpty: No Codex accounts yet. Create an account to authorize it.
codexResetCreditAutoHelp: Looks for available rate-limit reset credits daily and uses them before they expire; set the lead time and weekly cap in Settings → OpenAI
codexQuotaQueryFailed: Quota check failed. Check the credentials and proxy.
codexQuotaPartial: The reset-credit list is unavailable; the count comes from the usage endpoint.
codexResetCreditConfirm: Use one reset credit on “{{name}}” to reset its Codex usage windows now. This cannot be undone.
codexResetCreditDone: Reset credit used and quota refreshed
codexResetCreditFailed: The reset credit was not confirmed. Clicking again retries the same request and will not spend a second credit.
codexActionFailed: Account action failed. Check Worker status
codexArchiveConfirm: Archive “{{name}}” to stop new requests and remove group membership. Usage history and bills are retained.
codexDeleteConfirm: Permanently deleting “{{name}}” cannot be undone: the account is removed from every Gateway Worker, its credentials, proxy and group membership are cleared, and it no longer appears in any list, including archived. Usage history and settlements are retained. To stop new requests but keep the account, archive it instead.
codexDeleteBulkConfirm: Permanent deletion cannot be undone: accounts are removed from every Gateway Worker, and their credentials, proxies and group memberships are cleared. They disappear from every list, archived included. Usage history and settlement are kept. To stop traffic but keep an account, archive it instead.
codexGatewayOAuthHelp: After authorizing, paste the full callback URL.
codexGatewayCallbackHelp: Use the account proxy {{proxy}} in your browser to authorize, then paste the full callback URL.
codexBulkDescription: {{count}} accounts selected; only checked fields change.
codexBulkHelp: Every account is validated before saving; if any fails, none is changed.
codexTestHelp: Send a real conversation with this account through the Gateway Worker to verify credentials, proxy egress and the Worker path.
codexTestCredential: Codex OAuth · Gateway Worker / OpenAI Responses (this account only)
codexWeightHelp: Weight 1–100; higher goes first. Only the highest-weight available accounts are picked.
codexWeightRange: Weight must be an integer from 1 to 100
codexModelAccessAllowHelp: Serve only the selected models (exact upstream model IDs).
codexModelAccessDenyHelp: Never serve the selected models; others are unaffected.
codexModelAccessSearch: Search or type a model ID and press Enter
codexModelAccessCleanupSelection: Choose models to remove from the allowlist
codexModelAccessCleanupHelp: These selected models are not in the current catalog; that alone does not mean they stopped working. Save the account to apply.
codexModelAccessCleanupKeepOne: Keep at least one model in the allowlist
codexModelAccessRequired: Pick at least one model for the allowlist or blocklist
codexProtectionAwaitingProbe: Freeze expired, waiting for a successful probe
codexProtectionHint: Rules are configured under account error protection in settings; Recover cooldown also lifts the freeze.
codexProfileUnavailable: The account profile is unavailable right now
gatewayWorkerSingleMode: Only one Worker on the control-plane host is supported: while one instance is accepting, other instances get 409 on registration. To replace it, drain the old instance or wait 45 seconds without heartbeats.
gatewayWorkerSupervisorRunning: Supervised by the control plane: Worker running
gatewayWorkerSupervisorBackoff: Supervised by the control plane: the Worker exited and is restarting with backoff (see [codex-gateway] lines in the control-plane log)
gatewayWorkerSupervisorMissingBinary: Supervised by the control plane: bin/kin-codex-gateway is missing, so the Worker cannot start
gatewayWorkerSupervisorMissingSecret: Supervised by the control plane: the internal token is missing, so the Worker cannot start
gatewayWorkerSupervisorIdle: Supervised by the control plane: waiting to start
codexImportDescription: Import a JSON file created by “Export accounts file”: each account is created with its native authorization.
codexImportFileInvalid: Choose a JSON file created by “Export accounts file”
codexImportProxyFromFile: Use the proxy from the file
codexExportConfirm: The file contains the native authorization tokens of the selected accounts in plain text; anyone with the file can use these accounts. Export?
codexPlanOverrideHelp: Manually correct this account's ChatGPT tier (Plus / Pro 100 / Pro 200 / Pro 500 …). Affects panel display only, not the real upstream plan. While set it takes precedence; clear it to return to auto-detection (the tier seen by quota checks, otherwise the tier at authorization).
